objective: Test whether the existing defined-risk short-put-spread structure transfers to a frozen set of liquid US-listed ETFs when Qlib supplies bullish discovery ranks and live Robinhood quotes pass deterministic liquidity and asset-specific IV/RV gates.

scope.excluded: single stocks, leveraged/inverse ETFs, FX, crypto, indexes, futures, and every symbol outside the frozen map

entry_policy.request_freshness: The finalizer accepts only a request generated on the same America/New_York calendar date.

qlib.status: SHADOW discovery input; lack of promotion is displayed and never hidden

asset_volatility.realized_vol: annualized standard deviation of the last 20 completed daily log returns from the local Qlib CSV

contracts.long_put: same expiry, lower strike, nearest available strike to the frozen per-symbol spread_width
contracts.entry_price: natural executable-side credit: short bid minus long ask

trial_accounting.reason: One frozen strategy-underlying hypothesis for each of nine eligible ETFs; all retries and future parameter variants must increase this count.
trial_accounting.promotion: No promotion before canonical DSR > 0 and PBO < 0.5, at least 40 settled non-overlapping observations, cost/liquidity checks, and human review.

macro_policy.hq_macro_universe: context and audit metadata only; never a source of tradable symbols
macro_policy.macro_gpu: context only unless fresh; stale or missing stays unknown and cannot create a candidate
